summary: Prologis, L.P. filed an 8-K reporting the pricing of a $1.25B aggregate principal debt offering — $500M of 4.250% Notes due 2031 and $750M of 4.900% Notes due 2036, issued under an underwriting agreement. The filing is a routine capital markets transaction (creation of a direct financial obligation) and does not involve a special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, spin-off, restructuring, liquidation, or management change. The proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes. There is no change-of-control premium, break fee, or regulatory clock; risk-arb is not applicable.
